errors.evidence: The second category label on the x-axis is "До 250 служителя" (Up to 250 employees), not "От 50 до 250 служители" (From 50 to 250 employees) as stated in the description.
The y-axis scale has major tick marks and labels at intervals of 0.2 (3.0, 3.2, 3.4, etc.), not 0.1.
The description does not mention the label for the horizontal axis, which is "Размер на компанията" (Company size).
